violations.text: The food safety certificate for PIC at time of inspection was observed to be expired. Food safety certification is to be renewed as soon as possible. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026

The RIDOH CFP Certified Food Safety Manager License was observed to be expired. Upon renewing the Food Safety Certificate, PIC is to submit Certified Food Safety Manager application to RIDOH CFP as soon as possible. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink and sanitizer buckets was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 150-400 ppm. 3 bay sink sanitizer was manually added and rechecked at proper strength of 150-400 ppm at time of inspection. (PIC called for service to wall mounted mixer/dispenser unit at time of inspection.) Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed to have an accumulation of residue. Per the PIC, unit is to be emptied and cleaned. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026

The 3 Bay Sink Faucet was observed to be leaking when hot and cold water controls are turned off. Plumbing system and fixtures are to be maintained good repair. Maintenance Technician was notified at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed to have an accumulation of biofilm. Surfaces were properly cleaned at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/14/2025
